## Findings
- claim-1: For \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\) with \(t>r+s-n\), \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) is the unique nonidentity bigrassmannian in \(S_n\) with \(\Des(v)=\{(r\leftrightarrow r+1)\}\), \(\Des(v^{-1})=\{(s\leftrightarrow s+1)\}\), \(v_t=s+1\), explicitly \[ (1,\ldots,t-1,\ s+1,\ldots,s+r-t+1,\ t,\ldots,s,\ s+r-t+2,\ldots,n). \] [source-2@L973-L993|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: \(J_v:=\Bbbk\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\); in the type-\(A\) integral setting, \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) is treated as an ideal of \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\cong H^\star(G/P_J,\mathbb Z)\). [source-2@L334-L348|claim=formal-document] [source-2@L1344-L1350|claim=formal-document] [source-2@L1369-L1375|claim=formal-document]
- claim-3: The \(r\)-grassmannian \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) corresponds to the rectangle \(i^j\), where \(i=s-t+1\) and \(j=r-t+1\). [source-2@L1354-L1362|claim=formal-document]
- claim-4: With \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), set \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\) and \(b=\min(i,j)\). Theorem 5.4 states that \(J_v\) is generated by either \[ \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\} \quad\text{or}\quad \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}. \] [source-2@L1380-L1402|claim=formal-document]
- claim-5: The formal conjecture is: “The two generating sets for the ideal \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) given in Theorem 5.4 are both minimal.” The authors report computer verification for all bigrassmannian permutations with \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [source-2@L1489-L1502|claim=formal-document]
- claim-6: Taking \(M=J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\), the source conjectures that \(M/\Lambda_+M\) requires \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) generators and suspects the stronger isomorphism \[ J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}/\Lambda_+J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}. \] [source-2@L1536-L1552|claim=formal-document]
- claim-7: The related, formally posed type-\(A_{n-1}\) open question asks for a minimal generating set of \(I_w\), including for varieties defined by inclusions (avoiding \(4231,35142,42513,351624\)) and smooth varieties (avoiding \(3412,4231\)). [source-2@L1913-L1929|claim=formal-document]
## Strategy
- Fix \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\) under \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\), \(t>r+s-n\), with its descent conditions, \(v_t=s+1\), and explicit one-line form at [source-2@L973-L993|claim=formal-document].
- Use \(J_v=\Bbbk\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\) at [source-2@L334-L348|claim=formal-document]. Keep distinct its integral type-\(A\) realization as an ideal of \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\cong H^\star(G/P_J,\mathbb Z)\): integral extension is discussed at [source-2@L1344-L1350|claim=formal-document], and the displayed ring isomorphism occurs at [source-2@L1380-L1402|claim=formal-document].
- Set \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\); \(v\) corresponds to the \(j\times i\) rectangle \(i^j\) at [source-2@L1354-L1362|claim=formal-document].
- With \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), retain both Theorem 5.4 families:
  \[
  \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\},
  \qquad
  \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\},
  \]
  at [source-2@L1380-L1402|claim=formal-document].
- Distinguish: the formal minimality conjecture and finite computer verification for \(r\le4,\ n-r\le5\) [source-2@L1489-L1502|claim=formal-document]; the quotient-generator conjecture and stronger suspected free-abelian isomorphism [source-2@L1536-L1552|claim=formal-document]; and the separate type-\(A\) question about minimal generators for \(I_w\), including the stated avoidance subclasses [source-2@L1913-L1929|claim=formal-document].

## Gaps
- \(\Lambda_+\) occurs but is not defined in supplied evidence [source-2@L1536-L1552|claim=formal-document].
- “Minimal” is not defined in the cited conjecture; it must not be silently identified with irredundancy or minimum cardinality [source-2@L1489-L1502|claim=formal-document].
- No supplied evidence proves that either Theorem 5.4 family has \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements, nor supplies the quotient-to-minimal-generators implication.
- There is an apparent \(u/w\) variable-name typo affecting the \(r\)-Grassmannian discussion at [source-2@L1294-L1307|claim=formal-document]. No correction is justified from supplied evidence.
- The \(\Bbbk\)-span definition and integral ideal formulation have different stated coefficient/ambient-ring contexts.

## Next
- Obtain the exact definition of \(\Lambda_+\), the relevant module-action and minimal-generator proposition, and its hypotheses before using the quotient conjecture for minimality.
- Prove separately, if needed, the cardinalities of both partition intervals.
- Inspect the cited \(u/w\) passage against the formal source before downstream use.
